transcript.en: Right, Jason and Karin, now I asked you to look at the case study for Box Telecom as part of your exam assessment.
transcript.zh: 好的，詹森和卡琳，现在我想让你们看看关于Box Telecom的案例学习，这将作为你们考试评估的一部分。

transcript.en: It's interesting because they are in the middle of problems at the moment and I want you to track how they deal with them.
transcript.zh: 有意思的是他们此时正处于麻烦之中，我想让你们追踪他们是如何解决问题的。

transcript.en: Let's start with you, Karin.
transcript.zh: 卡琳，从你开始吧。

transcript.en: Having read through the case study, can you just summarise what the problems were that Box Telecom had to take on board?
transcript.zh: 读完案例后，你能总结一下Box Telecom面对的问题是什么吗？

transcript.en: Um, yeah...well, of course, what first came to their attention was that, despite a new advertising campaign, they were suffering from falling sales, and this is something that had many causes.
transcript.zh: 好的。首先引起他们注意的当然是销售额的下滑，即使他们做了新的广告宣传，这里面有很多原因。

transcript.en: On top of that immediate problem, what had also happened over the last two years was that, although they had invested in an expansion plan, they had to face up to increased competition.
transcript.zh: 除了当前的这个问题外，在过去两年还存在的问题是：尽管他们投资扩张，但是却要面对竞争的加剧。

transcript.en: And, before they had a chance to get to grips with the effects of that, they were stalled by a strike and it was just when they were thinking about making a colossal investment in new machinery for their plants.
transcript.zh: 在有机会认真处理这件事之前，他们又被罢工牵制，此时正是他们计划为工厂设备进行大额投资的时候。

transcript.en: So they were really in trouble.
transcript.zh: 所以他们真的遇到了麻烦。

transcript.en: Yes, I think that's fair.
transcript.zh: 是的，我认为这个说法说得通。

transcript.en: And Jason, you contacted the company, didn't you?
transcript.zh: 那么詹森，你和那个公司联系过了吧？

transcript.en: What did the company define as the reasons for these problems?
transcript.zh: 公司对这些问题产生的原因怎么说？

transcript.en: Well, I think they've hit on the right things—it would be easy to say they had invested too heavily, or at the wrong time, but in fact the signs were good and what they were set back by was high interest rates.
transcript.zh: 我认为他们做的对。简单的说是他们的投资力度过大或时机不对，但实际上市场信号良好，他们只是被高利率拖了后腿。

transcript.en: At the same time, their longer-term problems, which were affecting their market share, were eventually credited to poor training - and having looked at the details in their last report I think that's right.
transcript.zh: 同时，他们长期的问题最终归咎于差劲的培训，这影响了他们的市场份额。从上一个报告详情看，我想这是对的。

transcript.en: So, onto the larger issues then.
transcript.zh: 那我们接下来谈谈更大的问题吧。

transcript.en: Karin, what do you think the company will do?
transcript.zh: 卡琳，你觉得公司该怎么做？

transcript.en: Hmm ... well, obviously they have the choice of accepting the very favourable terms that another company - KMG Plc - have given them to buy them out.
transcript.zh: 显然，他们可以接受KMG Plc公司提供给他们的关于买断的优惠条件。

transcript.en: That would mean creating a new company with a new image.
transcript.zh: 这意味着以一个新的形象创建新公司。

transcript.en: Or they could decide on a bolder move and offer some new shares if they wanted.
transcript.zh: 或者他们可以选择冒险，提供一些新的股份。

transcript.en: But I think they're much more cautious than that and expect they will start trying to find individuals who'd be prepared to back them with some of the capital they need.
transcript.zh: 但是我想他们会更加谨慎，我认为他们会找准备为他们提供资金的支持者。

transcript.en: Well, you mustn't always assume that dramatic problems require dramatic solutions.
transcript.zh: 你一定不要总是想当然地认为，重大问题就必须要有激进大胆的解决方案。

transcript.en: Sometimes there's a simple fix such as changing the guy at the top.
transcript.zh: 有时，办法很简单，例如换掉高层主管。

transcript.en: If they truly are cautious, then I suspect they will seek to shut down some of their shops.
transcript.zh: 如果他们真的很谨慎的话，那么我猜他们会设法关掉几个商店。

transcript.en: But a more ambitious approach, and one which I think would have more chance of success, would be to alter how they're running things - the management layers and the processes.
transcript.zh: 但是更有野心，也是我认为最可能成功的做法是改变运营方式，管理层和加工流程。

transcript.en: So in your analysis try to think of all the options.
transcript.zh: 所以在你的分析中要考虑周全。

transcript.en: Jason?
transcript.zh: 詹森怎么看？

transcript.en: Yes, it's interesting because I've found it a really useful company to study.
transcript.zh: 是的，这很有趣，因为我发现这是一个对学习很有用的公司。

transcript.en: Its problems cross all types of industries and it's lucky it's so big - a smaller or even medium-sized company would have gone under by now.
transcript.zh: 它的问题涉及各行各业，幸运的是它是一家大公司，如果是中小型公司早就破产了。

transcript.en: Ah well in fact, what I want you two to do is to go away when we've finished our discussion today and write a report.
transcript.zh: 事实上，我想让你们俩做的是在我们讨论过后写一篇报告。

transcript.en: We've looked in general at the telecommunications market in the UK over the last few sessions and I want you to take Box Telecom as an example and suggest some ways in which they might overcome their problems.
transcript.zh: 在过去的几节课中，我们大致讨论了英国的电讯市场，我想让你们以Box Telecom为例，推荐一些帮助他们克服问题的方法。

transcript.en: And outline the reasons why you think as you do - but try and keep it intrinsic to the company rather than dragging in other examples.
transcript.zh: 概述出你的原因，但是要紧贴这家公司本身，不要扯进别的例子。

transcript.en: Is that OK, Karin?
transcript.zh: 好吗，卡琳？

transcript.en: Yes, I think I can do that.
transcript.zh: 好的，我应该可以做到。

transcript.en: Personally I've got great hopes for it.
transcript.zh: 我个人对它抱有很大的希望。

transcript.en: I think it will recover.
transcript.zh: 我认为它可以从失利中恢复

transcript.en: That advertising campaign they did was very strong and they're very innovative with their products - they set new trends.
transcript.zh: 他们的广告宣传做的很好，产品很有创意，引导了潮流，

transcript.en: The company's got to recover, don't you think, Jason?
transcript.zh: 公司已经开始好转了，你觉得呢，詹森？

transcript.en: Hmmm - I'm not sure.
transcript.zh: 我不确定。

transcript.en: I think it can but it's not a foregone conclusion unless they manage to attract the right level of investment.
transcript.zh: 我认为它会变好，但是不能肯定，除非他们设法吸引到适当的投资。

transcript.en: The company definitely needs a boost and to attract more highly skilled workers if their recovery is to be long-lasting.
transcript.zh: 如果他们恢复的时间很长，那么这个公司肯定需要改进，吸引更多的高技能工人。

transcript.en: When I was talking to the marketing manager he said to me that he thinks the company had got a great management team - but he would say that, wouldn't he?
transcript.zh: 当我跟市场经理谈话时，他告诉我他认为公司有出色的管理团队。他肯定会这么说，不是吗？

transcript.en: But they are suffering from having to work with outdated production machinery and that could cost a lot to put right.
transcript.zh: 但是他们的工作受老式生产设备的影响，要花很多钱才能扭转这个局面。

transcript.en: Well, personally I think the stock market is to blame.
transcript.zh: 我个人认为股市才是罪魁祸首。

transcript.en: I think they were expecting too much of the company and then inevitably it looked bad when it didn't perform.
transcript.zh: 我认为他们对公司的期望过高，当表现不佳时，不可避免的会变得糟糕。

transcript.en: The market should have had more realistic expectations.
transcript.zh: 市场本该有更多实际的期望。

transcript.en: And I disagree with you about the advertising campaign, Karin.
transcript.zh: 而且我不同意你对广告宣传的看法，卡琳。

transcript.en: That's where they could do with some innovation - to get sales kick-started.
transcript.zh: 他们本可以在这方面做一些创新，提高销量。

transcript.en: Anyway, let's see what you come up with ...
transcript.zh: 总之，让我们看看你提出的……
